summary: This research study compares different doses of the medicine NNC0519-0130 to see how well they can reduce kidney damage in people with chronic kidney disease, which means long-term kidney damage. The trial is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S and is currently recruiting 465 participants for this Phase 2 study. Participants will receive NNC0519-0130, semaglutide, or a placebo, which is an inactive substance with no medicine in it.
